The '''AD-4 Battledroid Centurion''' was a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used as security forces by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A number of AD-4 Centurions were among the security forces of [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]], a genetic research facility on Manaan.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The AD-4 Battledroid Centurion appears as an enemy in the Tactical Flashpoint "Depths of Manaan," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access. Strangely, the droids are only named in the standard version of the Flashpoint; in the Solo Mode, they are simply titled "Battledroid Centurion."<ref name="TOR" />
